Issue: GUIProcess startup errors omitted the command and error type.

Changed `qutebrowser/misc/guiprocess.py` so `_on_error` formats the capitalized process name, quoted command, specific QProcess error wording, and process error detail. On non-Windows, FailedToStart with `No such file or directory` or `Permission denied` adds the requested executable hint. Existing non-Windows crash notification remains handled by `_on_finished` to avoid a duplicate notification.

Updated `tests/unit/misc/test_guiprocess.py` to cover the real nonexistent-command case, all five requested error codes, and hint behavior across platform and error-detail cases.

- `pytest -q --reruns 0 --tb=short tests/unit/misc/test_guiprocess.py`: exit 0, 32 passed.

+    assert msg.text.startswith(
+        "Testprocess 'this_does_not_exist_either' failed to start:")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('error, wording', [
+    (QProcess.FailedToStart, 'failed to start'),
+    (QProcess.Crashed, 'crashed'),
+    (QProcess.Timedout, 'timed out'),
+    (QProcess.WriteError, 'write error'),
+    (QProcess.ReadError, 'read error'),
+])
+def test_error_types(fake_proc, message_mock, monkeypatch, caplog, error,
+                     wording):
+    """Show the command and the type of process error."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(utils, 'is_windows', True)
+    fake_proc.start('some-command', [])
+    fake_proc._proc.errorString.return_value = 'details'
+
+    with caplog.at_level(logging.ERROR, 'message'):
+        fake_proc._on_error(error)
+
+    msg = message_mock.getmsg(usertypes.MessageLevel.error)
+    assert msg.text == "Testprocess 'some-command' {}: details".format(wording)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('detail', [
+    'No such file or directory', 'Permission denied', 'Other error',
+])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('is_windows', [False, True])
+def test_start_error_hint(fake_proc, message_mock, monkeypatch, caplog, detail,
+                          is_windows):
+    """Offer a command hint for common startup errors outside Windows."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(utils, 'is_windows', is_windows)
+    fake_proc.start('some-command', [])
+    fake_proc._proc.errorString.return_value = detail
+
+    with caplog.at_level(logging.ERROR, 'message'):
+        fake_proc._on_error(QProcess.FailedToStart)
+
+    msg = message_mock.getmsg(usertypes.MessageLevel.error)
+    expected = "Testprocess 'some-command' failed to start: {}".format(detail)
+    if not is_windows and detail != 'Other error':
+        expected += (" (Hint: Make sure 'some-command' exists and is "
+                     "executable)")
+    assert msg.text == expected
